Player B: Thanks for finishing. I’ll complete C by moving it down to its goal at (R6,C1). I won’t touch B or E, and column 1 remains clear for any future needs. PLAN: move C from (R5,C1) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: none
All objects have reached their target positions!

Turn Moves.message: I see X at (R8,C4) is boxed in by walls and my A. I'll step up to (R6,C4) to open (R7,C4), then you can move X up. I plan to let X pass to (R4,C5), then return down to my target (R8,C4). D and F can use top/right routes meanwhile; I won't block column C4 below (R6,C4) for long. PLAN: move A from (R7,C4) to (R6,C4) — REQUEST: please move X from (R8,C4) to (R7,C4)

Thanks for opening (R7,C4). I’ll take B up to (R7,C4), freeing (R8,C4) for your A and starting B’s route toward (R5,C2). I’ll need your piece at (R6,C4) to move up to (R5,C4) soon so B can continue through (R6,C4) to (R4,C4), then top-left to C2. Later, please clear (R6,C1) for C and (R2,C3) for E. PLAN: move B from (R8,C4) to (R5,C2) — REQUEST: please move (R6,C4) to (R5,C4)

I'll move A up to (R5,C4) to open (R6,C4) for X. Next I’ll go to (R4,C4), then exit right to (R4,C5) so X can pass upward toward C2, then I’ll return down to (R8,C4). I’ll keep D and F on top/right routes; please clear (R3,C6) for D once X leaves. PLAN: move A from (R6,C4) to (R5,C4) — REQUEST: please move X from (R7,C4) to (R6,C4)

I’ll clear (R3,C6) for your D by moving E down to (R4,C6), which also starts E’s route toward (R2,C3). B can wait one step while your X at (R5,C4) moves to (R4,C4), then right, so B can pass to C2 and free C4. Later please clear (R6,C1) for C and (R2,C3) for E. PLAN: move E from (R3,C6) to (R4,C6) — REQUEST: move X from (R5,C4) to (R4,C4)

I’ll take A up to (R4,C4), then right to (R4,C5), so your X at (R7,C4) can pass up C4 toward C2. After that I’ll bring A down to (R8,C4). D should use the top route to (R3,C6) once one C6 blocker clears; F will vacate (R2,C3) for E soon. PLAN: move A from (R5,C4) to (R4,C4) — REQUEST: please move X from (R7,C4) to (R6,C4)

Thanks—moving B up to (R6,C4) as requested, so it can follow when A clears (R4,C4) to (R4,C5). B will take C4 up to (R2,C4), then top row to C2, avoiding (R2,C3) for E. I see D needs (R3,C6); C will head up top to vacate C6 and then to (R6,C1) once D clears (R6,C1). Please move A to (R4,C5) next, and F vacate (R2,C3) soon. PLAN: move B from (R7,C4) to (R5,C2) — REQUEST: move X from (R4,C4) to (R4,C5)

I’ll clear (R4,C4) by moving A right to (R4,C5), so your X at (R6,C4) can pass up C4 toward (R2,C4) and then top row to C2. Once it passes, A will rejoin C4 and go down to (R8,C4). I know D needs (R3,C6), so I’ll try to keep the C6 approach open; F will vacate (R2,C3) soon to help your top route and D’s crossing. Please move your X up one step now so C4 stays clear. PLAN: move A from (R4,C4) to (R4,C5) — REQUEST: move X from (R6,C4) to (R5,C4)

Thanks for moving A to (R4,C5); B will continue up C4 toward (R5,C2), using the top row to C2. I’ll try to time B so it doesn’t block C/E’s top route. I think D needs (R3,C6), so I’ll keep C6 open for now and let C start toward (R1,C6) next. Please keep (R4,C4) clear and have F vacate (R2,C3) when ready. PLAN: move B from (R6,C4) to (R5,C2) — REQUEST: keep (R4,C4) clear

I’ll move D up to (R5,C1), starting its route via C1 and the top row to (R3,C6). I’m keeping (R4,C4) clear for B and leaving the top row open for B, C, and E. F will hold (R2,C3) one more turn so it doesn’t block your top route; once B passes, F can vacate and A can rejoin C4. Please move B up now, and try to keep (R3,C6) clear for D later. PLAN: move D from (R6,C1) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: move B from (R5,C4) to (R4,C4)

I’ll start C up to (R1,C6), freeing (R2,C6) for E and keeping (R3,C6) clear for D. C will cross top left to (R1,C2), then down to (R6,C1), so D can wait at (R5,C1) until C leaves the top row. B can follow via (R4,C4), and E can use (R1,C3) once F vacates (R2,C3). I’m leaving (R4,C4) open for A/B. PLAN: move C from (R2,C6) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: keep (R1,C5) clear for C

I’m taking (R4,C4) so A can head to (R8,C4); please don’t put B there; move B down to (R6,C4) if needed. I’ll keep (R1,C5) clear for C’s leftward route. Next I’ll send F right to free (R2,C3) for E, and D can climb the left column once C leaves the top row. This should let C reach (R1,C2) and E use (R1,C3). PLAN: move A from (R4,C5) to (R8,C4) — REQUEST: move B down to (R6,C4)

I'm moving C left to (R1,C5), freeing (R1,C6) for E and starting C's route to (R6,C1). I think your (R4,C4) object needs the column-4 corridor to (R8,C4), so I won't push B down to (R6,C4); that would block it. Instead, please move (R4,C4) up so B can step up and exit right via (R4,C5). C will clear the top row before B or E cross, and I'll keep (R1,C3) open for E after (R2,C3) is free. PLAN: move C from (R1,C6) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: move (R4,C4) up for B

Good plan. I'll step A up to (R3,C4) so B can take (R4,C4) and exit right via (R4,C5), then A can descend column C4 to (R8,C4). Please move B up to (R4,C4) now. I'll keep (R1,C3) clear for E and avoid blocking C's route to (R6,C1); if C needs (R5,C1), I'll shift D right next. F will wait for the top row. PLAN: move A from (R4,C4) to (R3,C4) — REQUEST: move B up to (R4,C4)

I'll move B up to (R4,C4) as requested, then route B right via (R4,C5) and (R4,C6) so your A can descend column C4. I'll send E up from (R4,C6) next to free that cell. C will clear the top row left to (R1,C1) before B or E cross. This should free (R4,C4) for A and keep the top corridor usable. Please keep (R4,C5) clear and open (R2,C3) for E soon. PLAN: move B from (R5,C4) to (R5,C2) — REQUEST: keep (R4,C5) clear for B

I'll shift D right to (R5,C2), clearing (R5,C1) for C's descent and starting D's route via C2 toward (R3,C6). I'll keep (R4,C5) open for B. Please move B right to (R4,C5) so A can descend C4. I expect E will need (R2,C3); I'll move F left next to free it. Keep top row clear after C passes so D and F can cross. PLAN: move D from (R5,C1) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: move X at (R1,C5) left

I'll start C left toward (R6,C1), using column C1 to avoid (R5,C2). This frees (R1,C5) for E and begins clearing the top row for your D/F crossing. I know your A needs (R4,C4); I'll move B right soon to free it, so please keep (R4,C5) open. Please clear (R2,C3) for E and (R5,C2) for B when possible. PLAN: move C from (R1,C5) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: clear (R2,C3) for E

I'm moving F right to (R2,C4), clearing (R2,C3) for E and setting up F's top crossing. Your C at (R1,C4) should continue left toward (R1,C1); moving it to (R1,C3) helps your plan and opens (R1,C4) for F. I still need (R4,C4) freed for A, and D will use column C2, so I'll clear (R5,C2) next if B needs it. PLAN: move F from (R2,C3) to (R1,C4) — REQUEST: move X at (R1,C4) left

I'll move C left to (R1,C3), opening (R1,C4) for F and starting C's route to (R6,C1). Next I'll try to move B right to free (R4,C4) for A, if E can step up. Please hold F at (R2,C4) until E reaches the top row, so E can pass before F crosses. PLAN: move C from (R1,C4) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: hold (R2,C4) until E passes

Holding F at (R2,C4) for E. I’ll move D up C2 toward (R3,C6), freeing (R5,C2). Please route X via (R1,C1) so C2 stays open, and move (R4,C4) right to free A. E should clear (R3,C6) before D arrives. PLAN: move D from (R5,C2) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: route X via (R1,C1), move (R4,C4) right

I’ll park B right at (R4,C5) to free (R4,C4) for A and keep (R5,C4) open for A’s path. I think A may head down column C4, while D heads toward (R3,C6); please hold D until E clears (R3,C6). C will route via (R1,C1) to keep column C2 open. Next I’ll push E up, then C left, so F can cross after E passes. PLAN: move B from (R4,C4) to (R4,C5) — REQUEST: hold D, take (R4,C4)

I’ll move A down to (R4,C4), continuing toward (R8,C4). This frees (R3,C4) so F can go up next, and D can wait at (R4,C2). Your X at (R4,C5) is parked to free (R4,C4); I’ll keep moving down so it can use (R4,C4) later if needed. Please keep the C4 lane clear and leave (R3,C6) open for D. PLAN: move A from (R3,C4) to (R8,C4) — REQUEST: keep (R5,C4) to (R8,C4), (R3,C6) clear

I’ll start C left toward (R1,C1), freeing (R1,C3) for E and keeping (R2,C3) open. Next E can go up, then B can enter (R4,C6) and follow C6. A can use C4; I’ll keep that lane clear. D may need (R3,C6), but E and B will pass it briefly, then clear it. C will take C1 first, so B can later follow C1 to (R5,C1) and step right. PLAN: move C from (R1,C3) to (R1,C1) — REQUEST: hold D until E and B clear (R3,C6)

Good, C moving left to (R1,C1) opens the top row. I’ll hold D at (R4,C2) until your E and B clear (R3,C6). Now I’ll send F up to start its top-row route to (R1,C8), then down to (R5,C8). This frees (R2,C4) for D later. I’ll stay right of (R1,C4), so your C1 path is unaffected; please keep (R1,C5) to (R1,C8) open for F. PLAN: move F from (R2,C4) to (R1,C8) — REQUEST: keep (R1,C5) to (R1,C8) clear

I’ll send E up toward (R1,C6), opening (R4,C6) for B and starting E’s route to (R2,C3). I’ll hold before (R1,C6) until F clears your top-row lane, so I won’t block (R1,C5)-(R1,C8). D can stay at (R4,C2) for now. C will next take (R1,C1), keeping column 1 free for C and later B. If you can shift the X at (R4,C4), B can go left; otherwise B will enter (R4,C6) behind E. PLAN: move E from (R4,C6) to (R1,C6) — REQUEST: clear (R1,C6) for E after F

I’ll move A down toward (R8,C4), clearing (R4,C4) so your B can go left from (R4,C5) if you want. E can continue up to (R2,C6), and C can take (R1,C1). I’ll then push F right along the top to (R1,C8) and down, so please hold E before (R1,C6) until F passes. That will also free the top lane for D later. PLAN: move A from (R4,C4) to (R8,C4) — REQUEST: hold E before (R1,C6) until F clears

I’ll start E up to (R2,C6), holding before (R1,C6) until F clears. C will then take (R1,C1), opening (R1,C2) for B and D’s top lane. B can use (R4,C4) once A’s path is clear; please keep (R1,C4) open for E after F passes. PLAN: move E from (R3,C6) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: clear (R1,C4) for E after F

I hear you: I’ll clear (R1,C4) by moving F right toward (R1,C8), then down to (R5,C8). Please hold E at (R2,C6) until F passes (R1,C6), and move C from (R1,C2) to (R1,C1) so D can use the top lane. A will follow to (R6,C4) next, freeing (R5,C4) for B if needed. This should give E space after F passes and keep D’s route open. PLAN: move F from (R1,C4) to (R5,C8) — REQUEST: hold E at (R2,C6) until F passes

I’m taking C left to (R1,C1), opening the top lane and starting its route down column C1 to (R6,C1). I’ll hold E at (R2,C6) until your X/F clears (R1,C5) rightward. Please also clear (R4,C2) so B can use column C2 toward (R5,C2). PLAN: move C from (R1,C2) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: clear (R1,C5) and (R4,C2)

I’ll clear (R1,C5) by moving F right to (R1,C6), heading to (R1,C8) then down column C8. I know B needs (R4,C2) cleared; I’ll move D up next turn to open it. Please keep E at (R2,C6) until F reaches (R1,C7), so we avoid a collision. C’s route down column C1 looks clear. PLAN: move F from (R1,C5) to (R1,C8) — REQUEST: hold E at (R2,C6) until F reaches (R1,C7)

I’ll continue C down column C1 toward (R6,C1); it stays clear of your F. I’m holding E at (R2,C6) until F reaches (R1,C7). Next I’ll start B left/up toward the top lane, then down column C2 once (R4,C2) is open. Please move D up to free (R4,C2) so B can enter safely. PLAN: move C from (R1,C1) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: move D up to clear (R4,C2)

I’ll move D up to (R3,C2) now to clear (R4,C2) for B. C’s route down column C1 stays clear. Next I’ll push D to (R2,C3), opening column C2, then route D over the top to (R3,C6). Please hold B until D reaches (R2,C3). I’ll move F right next turn to clear (R1,C6); then E can drop down column C6 when safe. A will follow down column C4. PLAN: move D from (R4,C2) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: hold B until D reaches (R2,C3)

I’ll hold B at (R4,C5) until D clears (R3,C2), then B can use the top lane and column C2. I’m moving C down column C1 toward (R6,C1); it won’t block F or A. Please keep (R3,C1) open for C. I’ll keep E at (R2,C6) until F opens (R1,C6), then route E left to (R2,C3). PLAN: move C from (R2,C1) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: keep (R3,C1) open for C

I’ll move F right to (R1,C7), opening (R1,C6) for E and starting F’s route to (R5,C8). E can then go up and left toward (R2,C3), while C continues down C1. D will wait at (R3,C2) until E clears (R2,C6) and row 1, then D can cross via (R1,C2)-(R1,C6). A will continue down C4. Please let B know D will next open (R3,C2) for column C2. PLAN: move F from (R1,C6) to (R5,C8) — REQUEST: move E up to (R1,C6) now

I’ll move E up to (R1,C6) now, freeing (R2,C6) for D and starting E’s route via row 1 to (R2,C3). B will wait at (R4,C5) until E clears row 1, then B can cross to (R1,C2) and go down after D opens (R3,C2). C will continue down C1 toward (R6,C1). Please keep row 1 clear for E and B. PLAN: move E from (R2,C6) to (R1,C3) — REQUEST: keep row1 clear for E and B

I’ll move D up to (R2,C2), opening (R3,C2) for B’s C2 descent and starting D’s route to (R3,C6). D will cross via (R2,C3)-(R2,C4), then row 1 at (R1,C4)-(R1,C6), then down to (R3,C6). Please move E left to (R1,C5) so E clears row 1 for D and B; C can continue down C1. F will move right next toward (R5,C8), keeping (R1,C7) open. A will continue down C4 to (R8,C4). PLAN: move D from (R3,C2) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: move E left to (R1,C5) now

I'm moving E left to (R1,C5) as requested, starting E's route to (R2,C3) via (R1,C4) and (R1,C3). D can advance to (R2,C4) and wait there until I clear (R1,C4); then D can use (R1,C4)-(R1,C6). F can take (R1,C8), and A can continue down to (R6,C4). C will continue down to (R4,C1) next. B will hold at (R4,C5) until D clears (R2,C4) and (R2,C2) is clear. PLAN: move E from (R1,C6) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: advance D to (R2,C4), then wait for (R1,C4)

I’m moving D right to (R2,C3) toward (R2,C4), as requested. Next I’ll take D to (R2,C4), then wait until E clears (R1,C4); D can cross row 1 to (R1,C6) and drop to (R3,C6). Your E route via (R1,C4)-(R1,C3) to (R2,C3) should work; I’ll vacate (R2,C3) once D reaches (R2,C4). C can continue down C1, and B holding (R4,C5) is okay. F can take (R1,C8) next, and A can continue down C4 to (R8,C4). PLAN: move D from (R2,C2) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: keep (R1,C4) clear for D

I’ll take E left to (R1,C4) now, then next turn E goes to (R1,C3), freeing (R1,C4) for D. Please move D to (R2,C4) and hold there until I clear (R1,C4). That lets D use row 1 toward (R1,C6) later, while C can continue to (R4,C1) and B holds (R4,C5) until the top corridor opens. PLAN: move E from (R1,C5) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: move D to (R2,C4) and wait

I’m moving D right to (R2,C4) as requested, holding there until you clear (R1,C4). Then D can go up to (R1,C4), across row 1 to (R1,C6), and down to (R3,C6). Your E moving to (R1,C3) frees the top corridor; C can continue toward (R4,C1) while B holds (R4,C5). I’ll keep D out of row 1 until you do. PLAN: move D from (R2,C3) to (R2,C4) — REQUEST: move E to (R1,C3) next

I’ll move E left to (R1,C3), opening (R1,C4) for D. Then I’ll drop E down to its target (R2,C3). Please let D go up to (R1,C4) after I clear it, then continue toward (R1,C6)/(R3,C6). C can continue down column C1 toward (R6,C1); I’ll keep B from blocking your top corridor. PLAN: move E from (R1,C4) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: move D up to (R1,C4) next

I’ll move D up to (R1,C4) as agreed, then use (R1,C5) and (R1,C6) to reach (R3,C6). Your X at (R1,C3) can drop to (R2,C3) after this, and your (R3,C1) can continue down column C1. I’ll keep A and F clear of your paths: A will use column C4, F will use column C8. Please don’t block row 1. PLAN: move D from (R2,C4) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: keep (R1,C5) and (R1,C6) clear

I’ll finish E by moving down to its target (R2,C3), freeing (R1,C3). That should let D continue right from (R1,C4) through (R1,C5) and (R1,C6) toward (R3,C6). I’ll then push C down column C1 to (R6,C1) and route B via the top row later, keeping B out of (R4,C4) for A. Please keep (R1,C5) and (R1,C6) open for D. PLAN: move E from (R1,C3) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: keep (R1,C5) and (R1,C6) clear

Thanks—E is now at (R2,C3), so C can continue down C1. I’ll take D right into (R1,C5), then use (R1,C6) to drop to (R3,C6). I’ll keep A on C4 and F ready for C8, so I won’t block your B’s top-row route. PLAN: move D from (R1,C4) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: keep (R1,C6) clear

I’ll honor keeping (R4,C4) open for A, so I’ll advance C down to (R4,C1) toward (R6,C1). E stays at (R2,C3). B will wait for a clear route: either after A vacates (R4,C4), or via (R4,C6) once D clears (R3,C6). I’m not blocking your D’s (R1,C5)/(R1,C6) plan. Please keep (R4,C1) and (R5,C1) open for C. PLAN: move C from (R3,C1) to (R6,C1) — REQUEST: keep (R4,C1) and (R5,C1) clear

I’ll step D right to (R1,C6) toward (R3,C6), so B can later use (R4,C6). F will then take (R1,C8) and head down (R2,C8), (R3,C8), (R4,C8). A can later use (R6,C4). Your C should keep using (R5,C1), and I’ll stay clear of it. PLAN: move D from (R1,C5) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: keep (R2,C6) and (R3,C6) clear

B can now step left to (R4,C4) toward (R5,C2), then up column C4 to row 1 and down C2. I don't see this blocking D at (R1,C6), F at (R1,C7), or A at (R5,C4) heading to (R6,C4). I'll move B up next, freeing (R4,C4). C stays at (R4,C1) for now, so your C1 clearance still applies. Please keep (R3,C4) and (R2,C4) clear for B. PLAN: move B from (R4,C5) to (R5,C2) — REQUEST: keep (R3,C4) and (R2,C4) clear

I’ll advance D down to (R2,C6) toward its goal (R3,C6), keeping C4 open for B. I won’t move A yet, so (R2,C4) and (R3,C4) stay clear. F will next take (R1,C8) and descend C8. Please keep (R3,C6) clear for D. PLAN: move D from (R1,C6) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: keep (R3,C6) clear

I’ll continue B up column C4 toward row 1, since C3 is walled off and I must cross at R1. This won’t block D at (R2,C6) or F on C8; I’ll stay clear of C6. C will then take C1 down to (R6,C1). Please keep (R2,C4) open for B’s next step. PLAN: move B from (R4,C4) to (R1,C4) — REQUEST: keep (R2,C4) clear

I’ll move D down into its goal at (R3,C6), completing D. I’ll keep (R2,C4) open for B’s next step up C4, and I won’t block C8 for F. After D, I’ll send F right to (R1,C8) and down C8, then A down C4 to (R8,C4). Your B should be able to continue to (R1,C4); C can use C1. PLAN: move D from (R2,C6) to (R3,C6) — REQUEST: none

E is already placed at (R2,C3). I’ll move B up to (R2,C4), then cross via row 1 to C2 and finish at (R5,C2). This clears C4 for A’s later descent and stays clear of F’s C8 route.
